description: Register (or refresh) a push device for a contact, the way an app backend would after the app receives its token. Re-registering a token reactivates it and moves it to the given contact. Unknown emails become contacts quietly (no lists, no contact_added sequences).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

keys.description: Web only: PushSubscription.toJSON().keys with p256dh and auth.

permissionStatus.description: iOS/Android only: the notification permission the app read. Feeds the push opt-in rate and the contact's pushPermission attribute. Omit to keep the stored one.

platform.description: ios (APNs token), android (FCM token) or web.

subscriberId.description: Existing subscriber ID to link (instead of email).

token.description: APNs device token (hex), FCM registration token, or web subscription endpoint URL.

name: register_push_device

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `register_push_device` MCP tool.

created.description: True when the token was new.

device.description: The push device record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
